payload.text: PILLAR (CLAUDE.md guardrail 11 — mission-critical ops instrumentation with HdrHistogram p50/p99/p99.9, without diminishing hot-path performance). `LatencyRecorder::p99_ns` is the canonical p99 tail-latency readout: a pure read-only accessor returning `self.percentile_ns(99.0)` over the recorded latency histogram in nanoseconds. It reads the histogram, mutates nothing, and has no side effects — the p99/tail telemetry is computed off the bounded drain, never on the zero-alloc pricing core. This is the latency-budget observability surface referenced by docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1.2 / docs/SCALE-OUT.md.
